observable_result: A successfully generated signed report is durably stored and registered before the report page renders, even when contact fields are empty.
The signed snapshot digest deterministically identifies the report, so retries converge on one ledger row and one protected manager path.
A later consented contact submission enriches that row and preserves the existing email-delivery flow without recurring enrollment.
Invalid signatures, session-crossed snapshots, recovery digest mismatches, tampered recovery metadata, and noncanonical recovery paths are refused.
Recovery copies verified bytes into immutable report storage while leaving the pending source available to the existing contact flow.
